items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I never knew Tony Jackson, but I knew Tony's sister I met here, Mrs. Sutter.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. And Jelly Roll would come, and he would stay two and three hours, and I would take his music all down from him and make all of his copies. That's the way he got copies, it's the half-post. He'd have no way to take it down. And he wouldn't trust nobody but me.

Well, don't blame him, because people could steal it. I know Tony... I never knew Tony Jackson, but I knew Tony's sister I met here, Mrs. Sutter. And she said too that people would steal that music from Tony sometimes if he didn't care whether he had it published or not.
Irvin Barleen did a couple of pieces. Somebody took some of Tony's, I guess.
